symbols.read: The short setup has been invalidated: price never broke 722.40, and the regime now reads BULLISH even as the 4H direction stays bearish and the combined stance flips to SELL. Price at 729.66 is pinned directly beneath a fresh bearish FVG at 729.82–729.88, which now caps the immediate upside, while 722.40 remains the pivot separating the two regimes. The bias is conflicted — structurally bullish regime against bearish 4H and 1H trends — so the decisive test is unchanged: reclaim 737.02 to confirm the bullish flip toward 758.44, or lose 722.40 to revive the short toward 686.36. Compared to the prior read, the 719.67–728.71 support shelf is gone and a new overhead bearish FVG has formed, so the constructive lean is now weaker and only 722.40 keeps it alive.

The short setup at 81,033.66 is invalidated — price never broke the lower pivot and the 1H trend has flipped back up, so the bearish continuation case is dead. Bias is now neutral-to-constructive: the 4H stays bearish and the combined regime reads HOLD, but the only open FVG is the bull shelf at 80,772.98–81,755.01, which remains the support floor. The 1H is stalling again (82,460.01→82,245.93), so this is a range-hold between 81,033.66 and 84,352.00, not a directional trade. Invalidation: a loss of 81,033.66 revives the short toward 77,715.32; a clean break of 84,352.00 opens the upside. Versus the prior read, the 1H down-flip has reversed back up and the short is formally invalidated — the range-hold stance is confirmed, with the bias nudged slightly more constructive.

The short lean from the prior read is now invalidated: price rejected the 2,457.22–2,474.79 bear FVG and rolled over to 2,442.92, with the last 1H candle down 0.57% from 2,456.05 to 2,442.08, confirming the momentum fade flagged earlier. The 4H stays bearish and the combined read remains HOLD, but the regime has flipped to BULLISH, so the sell setup is dead and the 2,403.69 lower pivot is the line to watch. A clean break below 2,403.69 opens the bull FVG at 2,399.44–2,423.16 as the demand shelf, with the 2,227.50 target only in play if that shelf fails. Bias is neutral-to-cautious-long while 2,403.69 holds; invalidation is a sustained break below it, which revives the bearish 4H case.

Bias stays neutral-to-bullish but is weakening: price has slipped to 105.55, still holding the 105.05–105.13 bull FVG but drifting toward its lower edge, with the last 1H candle down 0.37% and the 4H still bearish against a 1H uptrend. The 107.16 trigger remains untested and now sits above price as resistance rather than an entry, so the prior path toward 107.16 and then 113.40 is intact only while the FVG holds. Invalidation is unchanged: a loss of 105.05–105.13 reopens 100.92, and the shrinking distance to that gap makes the bullish lean increasingly fragile.

The neutral-to-mildly-bullish read has been invalidated: the combined 4H+1H signal flipped back to SELL, the 1H trend turned down, and price at 57.10 is now pressing directly into the 57.0865–57.1075 bull FVG that was the prior read's line in the sand. The last 1H candle closed -0.30% and a fresh bearish FVG has opened overhead at 57.2795–57.377, capping any intraday bounce. Bias is bearish while price holds below 57.2795, with a clean loss of 57.0865 opening the 55.37 target; the short thesis is invalidated only on a reclaim of 58.41, which would also neutralize the 58.58 stop.

The 4H direction has flipped from bearish to bullish, resolving the prior 1H-up/4H-down conflict that kept the read at HOLD — the bias now tilts cautiously long above the 4,141.44 lower pivot. Price has eased to 4,156.05 with a new bearish FVG at 4,165.29–4,168.52 capping the last 1H push lower, so immediate upside is capped while the two bull FVGs at 4,153.075–4,153.125 and 4,154.88–4,157.91 sit directly beneath as the first support shelf. The SELL setup stays invalidated and the path toward the 4,217.40 upper pivot remains open, but the fresh bear gap means a clean reclaim of 4,165.29–4,168.52 is needed to confirm continuation. Invalidation: a sustained break below 4,141.44 re-arms the downside toward 4,065.48 and flips the combined read back to bearish.

Bias stays neutral-to-long but the stall below 1.353–1.3567 is now a fade, not a pause: the last 1H turned negative at -0.40% (1.34→1.33), the first down hour after the prior flat print, while 4H direction remains the lone bearish counterweight and keeps the combined read at HOLD. Price is still holding above the two bull FVGs at 1.3266–1.3291 and 1.3045–1.3218, which remain the support shelf over the 1.31 pivot, and the invalidated SELL from 1.31 stays dead with nothing re-arming it while 1.31 holds. Invalidation: a push through 1.353–1.3567 opens 1.3668–1.3704 and keeps the bullish regime intact toward the 1.43 pivot; losing 1.31 revives the 1.20 target and the short with 1.37 as stop.
